details.reasoning: The gold target identifies both Italy and China. The prediction names only China, so it omits part of the required answer.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The host chronology in [1] gives Italy two Games in the stated 20-year period (2006 and 2026) and China two (2008 and 2022). Comparing the complete host chronology for that period shows no other country hosted more than two. Thus the sources support Italy and China as joint leaders.
